hypotheses.justification: The conclusion should hold for any q. For each source, local integrability near q follows by applying `heatPotential_near_kernel_integrable` (or its spatial-kernel counterpart) with center q and radius 1, since q lies in its own closed ball. Away from that neighborhood the kernel is bounded, and compact support together with the Morrey assumptions gives source integrability via `heatPotential_source_integrable_of_compact_support`. Thus the integrands are integrable on the whole domain, allowing the same near/far integral decomposition and summability argument without requiring q to lie near z. The zero/junk cases do not obstruct this argument.
